title: Chicken Satay

items: 3 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs or breast

steps: Trim and cut the chicken into bite sized chunks and set aside.  (¾” pieces for bamboo skewers or 1-1.5” pieces for large skewers.)
Combine the remaining ingredients in a bowl and whisk until smooth.  (A blender works fine too)
Marinate for at least 30 minutes or overnight for the best results.
After the desired marination, skewer the chicken so that they are loosely touching and not packed tightly together.
Grill over medium to high heat, turning periodically, until golden brown with flecks of char and the chicken reaches 165°F internally, approximately 10–15 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve with peanut sauce.
sourceNote: Note: This dish is great with fresh cucumbers, tomatoes, and coconut rice.
